text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond got injured during 
training, so I rushed her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Just moving it a little hurts this 
much... The injury might be more serious 
than I thought..."
choice_data_list: Let's take a break for a while.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still... if I just sit still and rest, the 
dream I must fulfill will only slip 
further away.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Resting might be the most sensible choice. 
Even so, I... want to push past that and 
grow even stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I promise I will push through the pain... 
so please, could you let me continue my 
training?"
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I promise I will push through the pain... 
could you please allow me to continue my 
training?"
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, even while we stand here, the 
rivals we will face in the race continue 
to grow—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Haste makes waste, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The frustration lingers, but I will 
channel those feelings into my training 
once I recover from my injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once first aid was complete, Satono 
Diamond headed back to the dorm with a 
look of disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Now then, let's head 
back to the track.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (—I'm fine. If it's just this much...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Gasp!?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—It seems... my outlook was too naive. I 
am truly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself took its toll, and in the 
end, the injury ended up plaguing her for 
a long time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(—Pain of this level is something I can 
endure!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Now, making sure not to overstrain 
myself, step by step... I'll see this 
through!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Phew, phew...! Heheh, I pulled through...! 
Without letting the pain beat me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While being mindful of her injury, Satono 
Diamond pulled through the training thanks 
to her immense self-discipline.
